title: Artificial intelligence for degenerative cervical myelopathy imaging: a systematic review across tasks and modalities

image.alt_en: Review Figure 1 connecting cervical X-ray, CT, and MRI with six artificial-intelligence task groups
image.alt_zh: 综述图1，展示颈椎X线、CT与MRI和六类人工智能任务的联系

summary_en: This systematic review examines 103 studies of artificial intelligence for degenerative cervical myelopathy across MRI, CT, X-ray, and six task groups. It summarises current evidence and the recurring challenges of retrospective single-centre data and limited external validation.
summary_zh: 该系统综述梳理了103项退行性脊髓型颈椎病人工智能研究，覆盖MRI、CT、X线及六类任务，并总结了当前证据以及单中心回顾性数据、外部验证不足等共性问题。
